\begin{table}[tb]
\caption{Error budget of the NNLO fit (main database, forward points, theoretical covariance) and of the fit with
the Baldin sum rule (\Tabref{fits}), in units of $10^{-4}$\,fm$^3$. The fit uncertainty is the $\De\chi^2=1$
uncertainty with the normalizations and nuisance parameters marginalized; its components are the statistical
(point-to-point) uncertainties, the normalizations, the forward points (nuisance parameters $n_f$, $n_g$; for the
Baldin fit, the sum rule $\al_{E1}+\be_{M1}=14.01(21)$ instead), and the truncation uncertainty of
Appendix~\secref{truncapp}. For the NNLO fit these four components add in quadrature to the fit uncertainty; for
the Baldin fit the sum-rule component is defined as the quadrature difference between the fit and the fit with
$\al_{E1}+\be_{M1}$ fixed, which overlaps with the other components. The systematic uncertainty combines in
quadrature the six sources of Section~\secref{fits}: the truncation model (variations of $\La_b$, $\bar c$, $Q$
and the correlation lengths), the database selection (half range of the variants of \Tabref{fits}, excluding the
subsets), the release of the spin polarizabilities ($\ga_\pi$ free), the coupling $g_M$ ($\pm0.1$), the
parameters of \Tabref{params} (PDG values of $g_A$, $f_\pi$ and the masses, and $h_A$ for
$\Ga_\De=114$--$120$\,MeV), and the correlation model of the forward points (half the difference between the
correlated and the uncorrelated treatment; not applicable to the Baldin fit). The total adds the fit and
systematic uncertainties in quadrature.}
